description: Restart a service across a fleet of hosts in safe batches with configurable abort threshold.

service_name.label: Service Name
service_name.description: The systemd service name (Linux) or Windows service name to restart.

asset_group.label: Target Asset Group
asset_group.description: Tag name or explicit list of asset IDs to restart.

batch_size_pct.label: Batch Size (%)
batch_size_pct.description: Percentage of the fleet to restart per wave. Min 1%.

abort_threshold_pct.label: Abort Threshold (%)
abort_threshold_pct.description: Stop the rollout if this percentage of dispatched hosts fail.

rollback.description: Rollback re-issues restart_service to failed hosts. Service restart is idempotent.
